# README images

## Promotional illustration

`product-hero.png` was supplied and approved by the project maintainer on 2026-09-13 after generating the illustration in ChatGPT. It is included unchanged, with its original Chinese lettering, in both README languages. It is promotional artwork, not a product screenshot.

## Product screenshots

Captured from the running what-the-repo development UI in Microsoft Edge on 2026-09-13. The example analyzes the public repository [deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness), snapshot c291e7961a51.

- dsh-learning.jpg: a real four-step learning route and the understanding check from its first guided explanation. The demonstration conversation was created for this README.
- dsh-component.jpg: the task orchestration layer with the session task-list component selected, related connections emphasized and unrelated nodes faded. Captured as a viewport-region screenshot.

These are genuine captures, not mockups. Account details and earlier conversations are outside the captured view. No pixels or product text were rewritten. The example uses Chinese content in both language editions of the README.

The screenshots depict original project UI and generated explanations about DSH.
